name: Google DeepMind
summary: DeepMind won Go before it won language. Merged with Google Brain in 2023, it now ships the Gemini family alongside the field's widest spread of specialist models — video in Veo, music in Lyria, images in Nano Banana — and the longest context windows in production.

founders.name: Demis Hassabis
founders.bio: Chess prodigy turned neuroscientist turned games developer; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for AlphaFold.

founders.name: Shane Legg
founders.bio: Coined the term 'artificial general intelligence' in its modern usage and has published long-standing timeline forecasts.

founders.name: Mustafa Suleyman
founders.bio: Led applied work and policy at DeepMind; later founded Inflection AI and now runs Microsoft AI.
